result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: a stuck loading spinner obscuring the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image.

issues.description: A white circular loading spinner with green progress arc is stuck overlaying the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image in the 'Popular right now' section, obscuring the food photo.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card image finishes loading and dismiss the loading indicator on load complete or error; do not leave the spinner permanently centered over the image.
